outcome: A suspended card is exiled with N time counters, loses one each upkeep, and when the last is removed it may be cast free and a creature spell gains haste.
A card with suspend cannot be suspended if an effect would prohibit casting it.
Cost increases and additional costs still apply when a card is cast from suspend without paying its mana cost, so the cast happens only if they can be paid.
note: Points to 601.2b and 601.2f-h; the observable consequence is the adjusted cost.
